name: Southeast Aquatics Fund
summary: Grants to restore instream and riparian habitat, improve water quality and flows, and remove fish-passage barriers in river basins of the southeastern United States, delivered with landowners and local partners.

eligibility.rule: Not a U.S. Federal agency, business, unincorporated individual or international organization
Project is in AL, FL, GA, KY, LA, MS, NC, SC, TN or TX
Use no NFWF funds for ongoing compliance unless enhancing or improving baseline compliance efforts

documents: Project maps and/or diagrams of on-site work, if applicable
Statement of Litigation, unless a federal, state or local government applicant
Board of Trustees or Directors list, or statement that none exists
GAAP Audited Financial Statements, if not current in Easygrants
IRS Form 990, if not current in Easygrants
Single Audit, if not current in Easygrants

eligibility.quote: Ineligible applicants include U.S. Federal government agencies, businesses, unincorporated individuals, and international organizations.

Grants to improve the condition of aquatic habitats may be considered across the southeast region of the US (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas).

NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation and settlement agreements. However, grant funds may be used to support projects that enhance or improve upon existing baseline compliance efforts.

co_finance.quote: Match Requirement: Projects should have a minimum of 1:1 non-federal match funding. Non-federal match may come in the form of cash or in-kind services.

after_award.quote: NFWF asks applicants to select metrics that they will report on during and after the project period.
